breaking.change: A built-in screen draws an action row or button only when the game passes its handler. PauseScreen draws Resume, Settings, Controls, Save, Load, Quit to menu and Quit game only with onResume, onSettings, onControls, onSave, onLoad, onQuitToMenu and onQuit; MainMenuScreen its entries only with onContinue (and canContinue), onNewGame, onModes, onSettings, onCredits and onQuit, and its news card is pressable only with onNews; ResultsScreen Replay, Again and Continue; GameOverScreen Retry, Checkpoint, Quit, Revive and Decline; SettingsScreen Back, Defaults, Revert and Apply; ModeSelectScreen Back and Play; SaveLoadScreen Back, Delete, Load, New and Save; TitleScreen its press prompt only with onStart. Before, each was drawn and did nothing when pressed.
breaking.fix: Pass the handler of every row the game shows; a row it leaves out is not drawn, so leave a handler out (or pass undefined) to hide its row. Save still greys by canSave, Apply and Revert by pending.

added.summary: A game's own pause rows (Restart stage): `rows={[{ key: "restart", label: "Restart stage", after: "resume" }]}` and `onRow={(e, key) => …}`, drawn as the built-in rows, after the row `after` names or at the end of their group, a `minor` one below the rule.
